messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — Acme UK POC just asked for a single handoff of compliance artefacts (SOC 2 excerpt, ISO27001 scope, pen-test attestation). They want the bundle hosted in the UK and a signed pen-test letter. Can we confirm delivery method and whether eu-west-2 satisfies 'UK-resident' storage? They asked for the bundle by EOD Thu if possible.

devon_se: We can put the bundle together. Quick Qs: is SFTP required or are they ok with a secure S3 presigned link? Also rough size? Usually these bundles are ~20–40MB.

anya_sec: We have the SOC2 excerpt and ISO SoA ready (PDF). Pen-test: we can provide our vendor attestation + a short summary, but legal typically signs our pen-test-letter template. We also need to redact any sensitive findings (we never share full report). On hosting: eu-west-2 is in London — that should meet 'UK datacenter' ask, but will confirm.

maria_sales: Customer explicitly wrote "must be physically in UK datacenters" — please double-check. If eu-west-2 is London that should be fine, but they sometimes mean on-prem or dedicated.

sam_ops: Confirmed: eu-west-2 is indeed London region (physical datacenters in UK). For hosted artifact drops we can place S3 objects in eu-west-2 and restrict access. If they absolutely require on-prem/dedicated, that'll be a larger procurement conversation.

anya_sec: For the pen-test letter workflow: Legal needs to review/redline our template. I can attach the draft once Legal confirms. Also: note our policy — we provide vendor contact only in limited cases, not full findings.

maria_sales: Can Legal expedite? Client is waiting on timeline and could push POC start depending on this.

legal_bot: Automated: PenTest_Letter_Template_v3.pdf uploaded to /legal/attestations/ (internal link). To request signature, open a legal request PR. Expedited sign-off SLA: 48 hrs once PR is approved. :robot_face:

devon_se: Delivery mechanics: I can provision a temporary SFTP user (7-day window) and upload encrypted zip (AES-256). We typically deliver passphrase via secure channel. If they prefer presigned URL, I can generate a time-limited link in eu-west-2. Which do they prefer?

maria_sales: They want SFTP with a 7-day window. Also asked if hosting in eu-west-2 will change Dedicated vs Hosted pricing — they're evaluating whether to request a dedicated deployment for data residency. Can someone provide a ballpark for dedicated cost?

sam_ops: Ballpark for Dedicated (reserved capacity) for a small POC with modest throughput: ~15k–25k USD/month depending on GPU profile and retention. For just artifact hosting, no need for Dedicated — S3/eu-west-2 is sufficient. I'll draft a short note to include in the reply.

anya_sec: Plan & ETA: I'll collate _exact_ artifact list (SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 scope, pen-test attestation, redacted network diagram, and artifact inventory). ETA: Wed midday. If Legal can start the pen-test letter PR now we might hit Thu EOD. I'll default to encrypted zip + SFTP upload unless they push back. :lock:

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll confirm SFTP account details with the customer and ask them to sign the NDA portion for transfer. Also requesting Legal to start the PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

legal_bot: Note: If customer requests contact info for pen-test vendor, provide vendor statement only. Do not share raw findings.

maria_sales: Understood — looping in CS for final handoff and will provide a single consolidated timeline once Legal confirms signature ETA.
